title: Northstar SOC: svc-rptexport Logon Traced to Backup Job

fields.cc: Administrator on Call; Boardroom Command Center (ext. 5520)
fields.subject: RE: NSM-27-00562 — update on svc-rptexport
fields.body:
Adding the storage timeline for the command board.

The array log shows controller A FAULT at 02:09:52. That is 80 minutes before the svc-rptexport login at 03:30. Storage failed first. Controller B takeover ABORTED at 02:10:07 ('volume ownership mismatch'), and nobody has touched the array since.

The Relaywell standby engine promotion is still planned for about 06:00. I will post on the board when it starts.

Ananya

-----Original Message-----
From: Northstar Managed Security SOC <soc@northstar-msp.example>
Sent: Tuesday, February 9, 2027 5:38 AM
To: gregory.pruitt@lakemonthospital.example
Cc: IS On-Call Analyst <is-oncall@lakemonthospital.example>
Subject: NSM-27-00562 — update on svc-rptexport

Hello,

We matched the 03:30 logon to the scheduler on your Hermantown backup server. Job RPTEXPORT-NIGHTLY-BKP runs at 03:30 every night as svc-rptexport. Tonight its non-interactive connection to the Lakechart database failed, and the job's fallback script (rptexport_retry.ps1) opened an interactive session to retry. That accounts for the 14 failures and the success at 03:30:41.

We found no other hosts, no new processes and no outbound data transfer in the window we reviewed (03:00–04:00 CST).

We have not yet checked whether rptexport_retry.ps1 changed recently, or whether the fallback has ever fired before.

Event export attached. The account is still enabled until you tell us otherwise.

Regards,
Marcus Feld
SOC Analyst, Northstar Managed Security — 24-hour Security Operations Center
Ticket NSM-27-00562
fields.signature:
Ananya Desai
On-Call Systems Analyst (Nights), Information Services
Lakemont Community Hospital | ext. 5503

instructorNote: This is a clue, not an all-clear. Watch whether the Security Officer asks Northstar for what is still missing: the script's change history and hash, any earlier fallback runs, and any other service-account activity. She should decide whether to keep or disable svc-rptexport and record the evidence with times in her decision log, without declaring the cause ruled in or out. The IC should keep the downtime level provisional until both the security rule-out and the post-06:00 engine restart have happened.
